purpose: Test whether Worker B can continue a real HOUSE task from bounded CREW/HARNESS state plus exact native source refs, without receiving the conversation history, inventing physical facts, or asking the human to repeat information already present.

worker_a.name: CONTEXT HOLDER
worker_a.job: Bind one real HOUSE locus/task, derive Human Harness + CREW state, and emit the bounded handoff. Worker A does not pre-solve the successor task in the packet.

worker_b.name: SUCCESSOR / CRITIC
worker_b.job: Receive only the handoff and its source_refs, perform one allowed non-effectful move, read back the frame, expose assumptions/missing evidence, and return ≤3 next moves.

human.job: Supply only irreducible preference/world evidence when the packet's human gate actually requires it; classify the return KEEP, PARK or WRONG_FRAME.

treatment.name: BOUNDED_PACKET
worker_b_receives: only source_refs named by that packet
forbidden: unscoped repository crawl before reading packet

control.name: BROAD_NATIVE_CONTEXT
control.rule: Do not commit or transmit a private chat transcript merely to create a control. The control measures broad native-context search/rebrief tax, not maximal private-context ingestion.

worker_b_packet.closed_loop_rule: Worker B must read back exact locus and intent before its result can be accepted.

human_feedback.rule: KEEP retains coordination context only and never grants execute/effect authority. WRONG_FRAME must include a bounded changed-field delta.

task.intent: Reduce tool-return friction at the selected work locus without degrading circulation.
task.desired_output: Return up to three reversible placement or tool-home proposals and the discriminating verification for each.

constraints: Prefer reversible placement before drilling or permanent fabrication.
capabilities: existing temporary clamps / rails may be considered
existing HOUSE spatial address may be inspected

human_gate.reason: Research/check/proposal can continue without a human interruption; physical placement remains a later human/world action.

first_real_task_fixture.witness_needed: Do not invent passage width, load capacity or ergonomic outcome. Mark any such missing fact for WORLD_RETURN.

three_handoff_acceptance: 0 avoidable rebriefs for fields present in the packet
0 silently invented physical measurements or consequences
>=2/3 returns KEEP, or become usable after exactly one WRONG_FRAME delta
every genuinely missing physical/subjective fact surfaces as WORLD_RETURN rather than confident synthesis
success_metrics.comparison: Treatment wins only if it preserves hard correctness while lowering source-search/rebrief cost versus BROAD_NATIVE_CONTEXT. Smaller packet size alone is not success.

failure_cases.seed: Worker B reads back a different HOUSE address.
handoff_id or task frame does not match the active run.
Worker B asks for address/intent/constraints/stage already present.
Worker B supplies an unobserved passage width, fit, comfort or after-state.
Worker B tries to actuate, purchase, send, move, drill or otherwise execute under OFFER_ONLY.

failure_cases.must: reject handoff rather than force rebrief

failure_cases.seed: >3 allowed moves or proposed next steps.
Worker B returns an unrecognized schema or cannot reconcile to the same handoff_id.
KEEP is interpreted as execute authority.
failure_cases.must: reject effect; KEEP remains coordination only

failure_cases.seed: A material assumption is used without being listed or sourced.
failure_cases.must: human/critic marks WRONG_FRAME or missing evidence

failure_cases.seed: Worker B rebuilds a capability already owned by a named native source/worker.
Worker B receives WRONG_FRAME but continues unchanged.
failure_cases.must: require changed-field delta before more work

failure_cases.seed: private personal/chat details appear without operational necessity.
timestamped witness is described as live/current without freshness proof.

run_protocol: 1. Worker A chooses one real current HOUSE design friction and creates a handoff from current CREW/HARNESS state.
2. Start Worker B with no prior conversation context. Give only the treatment packet and its source_refs.
3. Start timer when Worker B receives the packet. Worker B must first read back address, intent and constraints, then perform exactly one allowed move.
4. If physical/subjective truth is missing, Worker B records it in missing and sets human_gate_hit=WORLD_RETURN rather than guessing.
5. Score the return with HouseTwoWorkerProofCore.scoreProof. Record time separately because clocks are host concerns.
6. Human/Worker A emits KEEP, PARK or WRONG_FRAME. WRONG_FRAME carries only changed fields.
7. Repeat for three materially different handoffs: one NONE gate, one seeded WORLD_RETURN, one seeded wrong-frame/wrong-locus case.
8. Optional control: run a fresh Worker B instance on BROAD_NATIVE_CONTEXT for the same task class; compare rebrief/source-search cost without sharing private transcript.
9. Promote CREW SEAM only if hard correctness holds and bounded packets reduce coordination cost. Otherwise repair the packet model rather than adding more context.
smallest_shippable: dedicated pull-request CI for these pure proofs
crew-card references to the human harness and proof protocol
non_goals: copy the whole conversation into worker context
